name: Source Code Patch & Repair
description: Patch unfamiliar source by finding the call path and changing only that code.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
See the application layout before changing it.
Find the code, docs, or config the task names.
Run the project tests after a code change.
Typecheck after a code change when the project has a typecheck.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.

validation.rule: The patch is limited to the code path that was read, and a compile, typecheck, or test result was reported.
